proposals.evidence: DEDR 5031 explicitly attests Tamil mūñci, Malayalam muññi/moññi/mōnta, Kota mōnd and Kannada mūti/mōti face. These survey forms are comparative members of the face/muzzle family, distinct from mukam in DEDR 4889. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
